exposure: digital home learning (study material and lecture recording)
outcome: simulation test performance (Time, Rumping, Legs, Body, Arms, Head, Total Point from Objective Structured Clinical Examination)
cohort: Thirty-two obstetrics and gynecology residents were recruited and randomized into two groups for training on vaginal breech delivery.
finding: Digital learning and formal lectures yielded similar results in resident knowledge and simulation performance for vaginal breech delivery.
